title: promotor de acessorios
description:
Atuar diretamente na promoção, exposição, oferta e venda de acessórios automotivos originais ou homologados, contribuindo para o aumento da receita adicional por veículo vendido e no pós-venda, agregando valor à experiência do cliente e reforçando a identidade da marca.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

1.) Abordar clientes no showroom e na área de entrega técnica para oferecer soluções em acessórios originais e serviços agregados;

2.) Realizar a exposição e demonstração dos acessórios, ressaltando benefícios, características técnicas, estética e valor agregado;

3.) Apoiar a equipe de vendas e de pós-venda na oferta conjunta de pacotes de acessórios durante o processo de negociação do veículo;

4.) Elaborar orçamentos e propostas personalizadas, alinhadas às necessidades do cliente e diretrizes comerciais;

5.) Registrar pedidos, acompanhar prazos de instalação e garantir entrega conforme padrão da montadora;

6.) Atualizar-se constantemente sobre o portfólio de acessórios, promoções e lançamentos;

7.) Monitorar o giro de estoque de acessórios e reportar demandas e oportunidades ao setor de peças e marketing;

8.) Realizar ações promocionais, vitrines, campanhas internas e externas para estimular a venda de acessórios;

9.) Zelar pela organização, limpeza e apresentação do espaço de exposição de acessórios.

ÁREA DE RESULTADOS (KPI's):

1.) Taxa de penetração de acessórios por veículo vendido;

2.) Ticket médio de venda de acessórios;

3.) Receita mensal por promotor;

4.) Índice de satisfação do cliente (pós-compra);

5.) Margem de lucro por operação de venda de acessórios.

HARD SKILLS (Competências Técnicas):

    • Conhecimento técnico sobre acessórios automotivos e aplicações por modelo/versão;
    • Capacidade de leitura de catálogos técnicos e manuais da montadora;
    • Técnicas de vendas consultivas e cross selling;
    • Noções de pós-venda e logística de instalação;
    • Informática básica e sistemas de orçamentos ou CRM.

SOFT SKILL (Competências Comportamentais):

    • Comunicação persuasiva e escuta ativa;
    • Proatividade e orientação para resultados;
    • Empatia e foco na experiência do cliente;
    • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe;
    • Organização e atenção a detalhes.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Médio Completo.

Desejável: Cursos técnicos ou profissionalizantes em vendas, atendimento ou mecânica automotiva.

Mínimo 1 ano de experiência com vendas de acessórios, peças, autopeças ou áreas correlatas no setor automotivo, varejo técnico ou eletroeletrônicos.

description:
Full time

Senior procurement delivery manager, Brazil

Brazil, Rio de Janeiro 1 day ago

Senior

Job Description

The Senior Procurement Delivery Manager, Brazil leads the Brazil regional procurement team. The individual will create and stand-up the procurement organizational construct to support the growth of the region. They are the most senior procurement person in region, and their team ensures regional procurement strategy, oversees purchasing processes, manages supplier relationships, mitigation of risks while ensuring cost efficiency.

They integrate business strategies and demand through aligned procurement category strategies ensuring the delivery of commercial excellence, they represent the 'voice' of the region for the end-to-end procurement process. They will liaise with other procurement teams to deliver the regions priorities, e.g. working with categories when that category delivers into their region. They balance business needs with category plans ensuring they are in alignment.

In addition, they act as the main point of contact for external partners to procurement (PPSA, suppliers, co-ventures, regulators, etc.), oversee cost recovery of third party spend and support business integrity and crisis activities to reduce operational risk and cost. Where applicable, they are a member of the Regional Business Leadership Team (BLT).

They are a people leader for the region overseeing people matters. They work with their peers to share ideal ways of working, making procurement more efficient and effective.

They cultivate partnerships with senior stakeholders and collaborate to deliver step changes in third party spend management. Their teams directly influence the business / entity financial plans and the overall value delivery of Finance – procurement. They have high commercial acumen ensuring alignment with business goals and delivering secure optimal, compliant, and competitive, risk-managed procurement outcome ensuring a safe, sustainable supply chain is in place.

A transformational leader, adept at change management, who builds high performing teams through displaying emotional understanding and fostering resilience.

Key responsibilities:
Region leadership: Oversees delivery of procurement headcount, budget, and annual targets for the Brazil region.

Builds high performing teams in the region through energizing and engaging leadership providing clear direction to their procurement delivery teams

As the senior role in the region, they have dotted line accountability for regionally deployed category teams resources, ensuring category activities in the region align with business priorities by working closely with category leads

Cultivates relationships with multiple senior business customers, aligning on business and procurement priorities and collaborating to deliver them

Delivers modernization & transformation activities, leading optimization of regional procurement delivery aligned to the broader procurement strategic transformation agenda

Manages business procurement performance to meet and exceed the relevant performance targets, safety and compliance metrics or targets

Team leadership: Builds high performing teams by fostering a culture of collaboration, excellence, and continuous improvement. Their team has deep technical skills and represents the interests of the region across procurement and the broader organization.

Builds region knowledge across the wider procurement organization to ensure delivery of their objectives

Develops the team's technical capabilities and nurture accelerator skills; curiosity in external markets, innovation and technological disruption, digital fluency, data-driven insights, and strong collaboration with stakeholders

Establishes an environment of psychological safety as a foundation for collaborative learning, ideation and innovation

Provides coaching and guidance to their matrix teams and dotted line reports on business delivery, external stakeholder interface, risk management and people matters

Promotes compliance with bp's Code of Conduct (CoC), policies and procedures to ensure compliance, actively demonstrate and role model bp's Who We Are expectations

Supplier & external relationship management: Uses storytelling to communicate with impact, respectfully challenging to achieve the right outcomes, resolving conflict and focusing on priorities

Skilled at leading and influencing through complexity and ambiguity, managing virtual relationships in multi-discipline, multi-cultural environments

Builds deep relationships, bringing market insights and championing supplier value whilst taking time to understand business needs. Becomes a trusted advisor and critical partner

Builds relationships with the procurement teams globally, understanding feedback and proactively working to build procurements reputation and value

Maintains close connectivity with procurement leadership, ensuring appropriate prioritization and resourcing

Provides procurement leadership to Operate by Other (OBO)/JV activities as necessary

Transformational Leadership and Change Management: Leads major change initiatives, which deliver incremental value to regions / sites / assets in a dynamic environment.

Oversees orchestration of change across a diverse stakeholder landscape

Uses digital tools to drive innovation and value creation

Uses storytelling and good communication to encourage adoption

Essential candidate requirements:
Leadership and communication: Strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills are essential for managing teams, relationships, and complex contracts. Influencing and integrating skills.

Experience: A minimum of 10+ years of professional experience in procurement or a related field, with specific experience in areas like government purchasing or local ordinances being a plus; especially given the need for PPSA engagement.

Technical skills: Proficiency with procurement and supply chain management software (e.g., SAP, ERP systems, etc.) and data analytics tools are frequently used to manage procurement process within the organization. Established supply chain strategy for region, including contract map.

Education: Bachelor's degree in business administration, Public Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is beneficial and or equivalent work experience.

Fluent in Portuguese and English

It would be beneficial but not essential to also have:
Experience standing up a new team and infrastructure.

Experience working in a matrix organisation

Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com colaboradores no mundo, contamos com escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui  aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos

e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar

a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à  identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei.   • Atualizar tempestivamente os PCs, reportando o status de acordo com as orientações;
  • Acompanhar, analisar e apresentar relatório semanal com a situação dos PCs que tiveram (materiais, quantidade, fornecedor, contrato, status do envio e aceite pelo fornecedor dentre as informações);

  • Revisar pedidos de compras;
  • Interagir com outras áreas, como fornecedores, planejamento, demandantes, gestão contratual, diligenciamento, armazéns, tributário e outras, a fim de solucionar eventuais pendências nos PCs, até o término do processo - pagamento ao fornecedor;
  • Manter atualizadas e organizadas as informações e registros de ocorrências sobre os PCs;
  • Apoiar nas negociações e tratativas referentes aos PCs, junto aos fornecedores;
  • Organizar, participar, intermediar e registrar reuniões com fornecedores e/ou áreas internas, bem como acompanhar e/ou executar plano de ação definido;
  • Elaborar e apresentar, quinzenal e/ou mensalmente, relatório com indicadores de acompanhamento das atividades descritas nesse posto de serviço;
  • Atuação desde a emissão do PC até o pagamento ao fornecedor, regularizando o processo a fim de que o encerramento do pedido seja realizado sem pendências;
  • Realizar as tratativas necessárias para aprovação de multas, bem como análise de histórico, elaboração de relatório e levantamento de evidências para devolução de multas;
  • Apoio na execução das atividades referentes ao encerramento do PCs, bem como no arquivamento de sua documentação;
  • Demais atividades necessárias ao suporte à gestão de contratos de bens de operação e/ou de investimento.

EXPERIÊNCIA

 
  • Mínima de 2 anos, comprovada em Carteira de Trabalho (ou outro tipo de contrato de trabalho), Desejável: Atuação em suprimentos, logística, supply chain ou áreas correlatas

FORMAÇÃO

  • Formação: Qualquer área, com diploma (ou certificado) devidamente registrado, fornecido por instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).

CONHECIMENTOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Domínio da língua vernácula e habilidade de redação técnica;

  • Sistema SAP e suas derivações (Ariba, 4HANA, YARD, etc);

O processo seletivo inclui análise curricular, análise dos documentos marítimos e avaliação médica. Poderemos entrar em contato por telefone para esclarecer quaisquer dúvidas.
Após se cadastrar, deverá aguardar o nosso contato.

Boa sorte 

A Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é uma joint venture entre a Wilson Sons e a Ultramar. A Wilson Sons é um dos maiores operadores integrados de serviços marítimos, portuários e de logística do Brasil, com mais 180 anos de experiência. A Ultramar é um grupo chileno com mais de 60 anos de experiência, presença em 15 países e grande experiência em serviços de agenciamento marítimo, apoio portuário, logística e transporte.

Com 22 embarcações, a Wilson Sons Offshore oferece apoio marítimo a plataformas de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás. No trajeto entre as plataformas e os terminais portuários, as embarcações PSV transportam equipamentos, lama de perfuração, tubos, cimento e alimentos, entre outros materiais necessários ao negócio dos clientes da indústria de petróleo e gás, e trazem ao continente os dejetos acumulados nas plataformas. Além disso, a empresa também opera com embarcações LSV.

Trata-se do segmento mais jovem da Wilson Sons: suas atividades foram iniciadas em 2003. Hoje já contamos com uma das maiores e mais modernas frotas em apoio Offshore com bandeira brasileira.

O compromisso da Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é continuar investindo para apoiar o crescimento de seus clientes e do Brasil. A meta deste ano frente a este cenário desafiador é a redução dos custos e o aumento de produtividade.

Importante: todas as vagas da Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore também estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência.

‌"O processo de recrutamento e seleção na WSUT está em conformidade com as exigências da Lei 13.709/2018 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, e trata de maneira segura e objetiva os dados pessoais dos candidatos às nossas vagas. As informações enviadas pelos candidatos, por ocasião de sua inscrição em processos seletivos ou envio de currículos para composição de base de talentos, são tratadas única e exclusivamente para o enquadramento em oportunidades de trabalho, busca e contato com o candidato. A WSUT não compartilha nenhum dado pessoal com demais áreas internas da empresa e tampouco para empresas terceiras. Todos os dados são descartados de forma segura ao final de cada processo de seleção ou quando mantidos em banco de talentos o mesmo se dá pelo período máximo de 365 dias, estando facultado aos titulares dos dados o acesso, atualização e pedido de exclusão."

description:
A função do Cumim envolve recepcionar clientes, apresentar o cardápio, anotar pedidos, servir alimentos e bebidas, e garantir a limpeza e organização do salão. O profissional também precisa ter excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente, comunicação e trabalho em equipe, além de agilidade e atenção aos detalhes para proporcionar uma experiência positiva ao comensal. Principais responsabilidades

  • Atendimento ao cliente: Receber os clientes, conduzi-los às mesas e apresentar o cardápio, esclarecendo dúvidas sobre pratos, ingredientes e porções.
  • Anotação e transmissão de pedidos: Anotar pedidos com precisão e transmiti-los à cozinha ou ao bar, seguindo os procedimentos do estabelecimento.
  • Serviço: Servir alimentos e bebidas, garantindo a apresentação adequada e organizando-os nos pratos e copos.
  • Organização e limpeza: Preparar as mesas com pratos, talheres e guardanapos, recolher utensílios sujos e manter o salão limpo e organizado.
  • Gestão de pagamentos: Apresentar a conta e receber o pagamento ao final da refeição.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de cozinha e outros membros para garantir o bom funcionamento do serviço.

Habilidades e qualificações

  • Atendimento ao cliente: Ser cortês, atencioso e proativo para garantir a satisfação do cliente.
  • Habilidades interpessoais: Ter boas habilidades de comunicação e a capacidade de manter a calma e o profissionalismo, mesmo em situações de pressão.
  • Agilidade e eficiência: Ser capaz de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente e se mover com rapidez em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Resistência física: Ter boa condição física para ficar em pé e caminhar por longos períodos e carregar bandejas.
  • Conhecimento: Ter conhecimento sobre o cardápio, os ingredientes, possíveis alergias alimentares e, em alguns casos, conhecimentos básicos de informática e noções de idiomas podem ser um diferencial.

SOBRE NÓS
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.
Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.
O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas".
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?
Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Department: Technical & Infrastructure
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimization by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.
The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.
The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA's stringent standards.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Planning & Operational Readiness
Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.
Operational Coordination & Delivery
Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.
Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure
Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.
Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution
Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.
Team & Contractor Coordination
Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.
YOUR PROFILE
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
Good reporting and documentation skills.
Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Global Recruiter
description:
About Us
Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.
We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.
We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.
Role Description
Airswift is looking for a Global Recruiter to join Rio de Janeiro office.
The Global Recruiter will focus on recruitment delivery to existing & new customers. The Global recruiter will work in recruitment and will develop a deep understanding of the recruitment process while building strong relationships with candidates and clients. The professional will work closely with senior consultants to help meet client needs by sourcing, screening, and placing candidates across various roles.
Principle Accountabilities:
Source suitable candidates for open job roles using various channels such as job boards, social media, networking, and internal databases.
Review resumes, conduct phone interviews, and assess candidates' skills and experience to match client requirements.
Present shortlisted candidates to clients, providing detailed profiles and relevant insights on their qualifications and experience.
Schedule and coordinate interviews between clients and candidates, ensuring a smooth process from start to finish.
Provide feedback to candidates after interviews and keep them updated on the hiring process. Communicate client feedback and help candidates prepare for interviews.
Assist with administrative tasks, including managing candidate data, preparing contracts or offers, and maintaining accurate records in the recruitment system.
Work closely with senior consultants and other team members to ensure recruitment targets are met and clients' needs are effectively addressed.
Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:
Bachelor's degree (completed or about to be)
Fluent in English (Spoken and written)
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, etc.) and an aptitude for learning new software tools.
Drive to meet and exceed targets, whether related to calls, submissions, interviews, and placements
Ability to work independently and stay motivated even during slow periods or after facing rejection.
Eagerness to learn about the recruitment industry and develop a career in recruitment.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, coordinate schedules, and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative and able to work as part of a team to meet both individual and collective goals.
Open to learning and taking on new challenges, and comfortable with change in a dynamic environment.
What we can offer you
Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally
World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
Career breaks available after one year.
Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.
Our Core Values:
Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.
Visit our website and social media to find out more -

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

description:

A New Wave é uma empresa global de tecnologia focada no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para a indústria minero-metalúrgica, com forte atuação em projetos ligados à transição energética.

Somos uma empresa que atua com tecnologias disruptivas, investimento em Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento e parcerias globais, desenvolvendo soluções que reduzem emissões, otimizam recursos naturais e promovem a economia circular.

Venha ser um Waver

Sobre a Posição
Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos aplicados a processos industriais, dados experimentais e bases operacionais. Avaliar desempenho de modelos por meio de métricas como RMSE, MAE, R² e validação cruzada;

Graduação em Engenharia, Estatística, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência sólida com Python ou R, incluindo bibliotecas como pandas, numpy e scikit-learn;

Forte base estatística consistente aplicada à modelagem preditiva;

Experiência com pipelines de machine learning e versionamento com Git;

Vivência com análise de dados industriais ou de processos;

Conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem como AWS, Azure ou GCP.

Atuação em projetos estratégicos e inovadores, com impacto global;

Ambiente dinâmico, em rápida expansão internacional;

Cultura colaborativa, com foco em tecnologia, inovação e sustentabilidade;

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Long Description
APPLICATIONS OPEN – until March 6, 2026
The deadline may be changed without prior notice.

The Principal Engineer will act as the Product Organisation's representative for the Brazil region and will serve as the primary point of contact for all ICM product related activities, with particular focus on Mechanically Lined Pipe products.

This role requires applying technical expertise to support the region in the advancement and promotion of Subsea7's Internal Corrosion Management products for client projects, new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

The Principal Engineer will also manage communications and actions associated with clients and therefore must demonstrate strong collaboration and communication skills, engaging effectively with stakeholders at all organisational levels.

The role requires solid understanding of pipe manufacturing processes, pipeline fabrication and installation methods combined with significant theoretical and practical expertise in Corrosion Resistant Alloy materials and associated pipeline solutions.

Key responsibilities include providing technical and commercial product support for early engagement activities and project strategies, building and maintaining relationships with internal stakeholders, clients and suppliers, ensuring accurate technical communication, supporting product strategy definition, identifying and eliminating product cost of loss, providing support to Supply Chain Management, leading product development programmes and participating in Communities of Experts. The role will also gather and maintain regional market intelligence, regulatory updates and technological advancements relevant to ICM products.

Key Responsibilities

The Principal Engineer will -

  • Product Technical and Commercial Support: Provide technical product information (including product design and operational envelopes) and commercially appropriate product recommendations and guidance to key stakeholders in support of early engagement activities and project win strategies.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Communications: Build and maintain relationships with key internal and external (clients and suppliers) stakeholders.

Provide clear and accurate product communications (verbally, written or via presentations), both technical and commercial, to internal audiences including senior management.

Ensure accuracy and alignment of product information across key internal stakeholders and externally with clients and suppliers.

  • Provide Input to Product Strategy: Work with the Product Director and Product Engineering Manager to ensure product roadmaps and team activities remain accurate and relevant to the region. In addition, the Principal Engineer will help maintain product trend analysis, SWOT analysis and competition analysis.
  • Eliminate Product Cost of Loss: Utilising information streams such as project feedback, Lessons Learned, product risk matrices, Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Supplier Performance Incidents (SPIs), identify and execute opportunities for product improvements and to eliminate product associated cost of loss for future projects.
  • Supply Chain Support: Provide technical support to Supply Chain Management regarding suppliers of ICM pipeline products, including market assessments, leading qualification activities and facilitating discussions around product schedule, quality, cost, etc.
  • Lead Product Development Programmes: Ensure new products are developed, and introduced to the market, in line with Company processes and product strategy. In addition, lead product portfolio expansion projects such as new material selection and qualification.
  • Community of Experts (CoE) Participation: Participate and contribute in relevant CoE meetings. Provide product input and perspective for the purpose of the development of technical standards and specifications.
  • Product Related Market Intelligence: Gather regional product associated market information to support product team strategies. Maintain awareness of regional regulatory and client specification changes and product associated technological advancements.

Skills And Experience
Masters Degree qualified in relevant subject (ideally Materials - Metallurgy based).

  • Thorough understanding of pipe manufacturing processes, fabrication and installation methods.
  • Significant theoretical and practical understanding of CRA materials and associated pipeline solutions (in particular Mechanically Lined Pipe).
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills at all levels of the business. Ability to create and deliver reports and presentations.
  • Effective analytical skills, applies creative problem solving, will suggest and develop new methods and ways of working.
  • A collaborative worker who builds effective relationships across a highly diverse global business.
  • Self-motivated, takes ownership of responsibilities and works with minimum supervision, while also contributing to the wider team activities.
  • Pro-active planning and organising skills, able to identify and effectively prioritise workload and successfully meet multiple, competing deadlines.
  • Flexible to adapt to changing priorities within a fast-paced 24/7 global business.
  • Progressive thinking, pro-actively seeks to develop own learning and development.
  • Committed to continuous improvement and identification of efficient work methods and processes.
  • IT proficient across MS Office.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

We value diversity and see differences as opportunities rather than barriers, ensuring full development conditions for our professionals and also for society.
All of our positions are open to people with disabilities and/or those who have been rehabilitated.

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams.

From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt);
  • Create local velocity scenarios;
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps);
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights;
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About the Team:

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications:

  • Master's or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

Benefits:

Our Hiring Process

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don't hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

Detalhes da vaga


Requisitos:

- Formação: Curso Técnico em Enfermagem.

- Registro no COREN RJ ativo e em regularidade.

- Desejável vivência anterior com as rotinas de unidade intensiva ou emergência pediátrica.

Atividades:

- Cumprir os protocolos de assistência criados pela unidade, aplicando todas as medidas preventivas específicas, visando garantir a segurança do paciente.

- Conferir e repor o carro e maleta de PCR, após a utilização em situações emergenciais, a fim de garantir sua prontidão para novas situações.

- Fazer conferência mensal dos materiais permanentes e consignados (VALIDADE).

-Contactar equipe médica e anestesistas sobre procedimentos eletivos e emergências.

-Preparar sala e mesas para exames e/ou cirurgias.

-Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os médicos nos procedimentos realizados, tais como: Cateterismo Cardíaco, Angioplastia (coronariana e vascular), Arteriografias (cerebral, renal, pulmonar, medular, mesentérica, MMII e MMSS, Drenagem Biliar, Colocação de Filtro de Veia Cava e PICC, Embolização Cerebral, Quimoembolização (hepáticas, uterinas e mesentéricas), Estudo Eletrofisiológico + Ablação, Aortografia.

-Utilizar EPIs específicos: capote de chumbo, protetor de tireoide, óculos plumbífero, dosímetro, (sala de Hemodinâmica chumbada com aparelho de intensificador de Raio X).

-Verificar os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.

-Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade em sala, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu exame.

-Confirmar e checar JEJUM, ALERGIA, especificamente à IÔDO com o paciente.

-Receber e preparar o paciente na sala de Hemodinâmica:

-Identificação do paciente no livro de sala com número de exame, médico que realizará o procedimento, horários de início e término;

-Cuidados de enfermagem: posicionamento do paciente na mesa de exame, monitorização (Sapo², F.C, F.R, PNI, PAM, Temperatura., Co²), punção venosa periférica,sondagem vesical, aspiração orotraqueal, oxigenioterapia, administração de medicamentos, assepsia e antissepsia.

-Cobrança de folha dos materiais utilizados em sala durante os exames.

Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob seus cuidados em sala, registrando na evolução qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.

Outras informações:

- Local de trabalho: Freguesia(Jacarepaguá) , Rio de Janeiro.

- Escala de trabalho: À combinar.

- Disponibilidade para treinamento de 30 dias como diarista.

title: Senior Service Technician
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron's 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Your responsibilities:

  • In this position, the Service Technician will be responsible for carrying out service and maintenance tasks on turbochargers, working both at company facilities and at customer sites. In this role you will be responsible for performing service and maintenance on Turbochargers in Brazil.

  • The role provides specialized technical support, executing activities in accordance with Accelleron workflows, quality standards, and safety guidelines — ensuring superior customer experience and operational excellence.

  • Service Delivery: Performs Service tasks like disassembly, cleaning, inspection, measurement and assembly of different types of turbochargers, in accordance with work instructions, through the identification of technical problems, carrying out remote and in-person analyses at the Workshop and or in the field in various categories of vessels (ships, platforms, etc.) and thermoelectric plants. In the field it means by performing installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, updates, renovations and replacements, among others, meeting customer expectations and pre-established internal procedures.

  • Customer Approach: Contributes to customer satisfaction by executing Service work according to customer order and expectation Creates and maintains a good relationship with customers and understands their needs Identifies new sales opportunities and communicates them internally. Execute the repair according to instructions from service coordination

  • Materials & Supply: Coordinates, prepares and ensures that all materials, parts and equipment are available and at the appropriate quality for Service activities.

  • Documents & Reports: Prepares all documents and reports to be signed by the customer representative Reports work done in a timely manner and follows up when needed. Perform maintenance inspections and reports on turbochargers, as well as perform investigation and prepare reports for breaking down situations. Clean up parts and take pictures and measurements as requested by maintenance tool and process.

  • Troubleshooting: Proactively identifies potential equipment failures and requests proactive corrective actions Troubleshoots equipment failure and makes recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future.

  • Operational Excellence Proactively identifies suggestions for product and quality improvement and communicates them further in the Accelleron organization Provides recommendations to management to improve operations and customer service.

  • Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality and Integrity: Applies safety rules and safe practices, environmental responsibilities as well as quality process. Reports unsafe practices and incidents.

Your background:

Education and Experience

  • Technical training in Mechanics with an active CFT (Mechanical Technician Certificate);

  • Experience in maintenance and service of rotating machinery, engines and turbochargers (minimum 10 years), large combustion engines, and/or mechanical technologies related to the maritime segment;

  • Experience in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including the use of precision measuring instruments, hand tools, hydraulic and pneumatic tools, etc;

  • Certified or experienced in lifting operations, overhead crane handling, and electric forklift, work at height, ensuring compliance with industrial safety standards;

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Planner etc.);

  • Portuguese as native language and Advanced English;

  • Availability for national and international travel to execute services and training;

  • Active driver's license;

  • Passport.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in working within regulations and rules, following management guidelines;

  • Service and solution-oriented mindset, with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills;

  • Customer and results orientation;

  • Responsibility, autonomy, and commitment to safety;

  • Effective communication and teamwork;

  • Proven capability to perform well under emergency work demand;

  • Proactivity and continuous improvement mindset.

Job Conditions

  • Employment type: Full-time;

  • Location: Rio de Janeiro - Brazil

  • Modality: Workshop and Field (customer site) activities. Weekly adapted based on the customer's demand;

  • Flexibility to work outside of normal business hours;

  • Available to travel: Required across Brazil neighboring countries (Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Argentina);

  • Report to: Workshop Manager.

title: Computational Fluid Dynamics
description:
About Us
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world's most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About The Role
Risk Management unit Brazil is seeking a talented Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)/ Process Safety Senior/Principal Consultant with a proven ability to tackle complex technical challenges, to join a fast-paced technical safety consultancy at the cutting edge of risk analysis techniques. This a great opportunity to be part of a motivated team that is a trusted voice to tackle global transformations and challenges, helping our customers in achieving the safety of their assets and operations.

The Risk Management South America team provide a wide range of advisory safety engineering and risk management services to the energy industry, for CAPEX and OPEX projects, in Brazil and worldwide. The Senior/Principal Consultant is expected to liaise with and support several customers and stakeholders including regulatory agencies mainly in the upstream segments, but also in midstream and downstream segments, and tackle energy transition topics, such as BESS, CCS and Hydrogen.

The Senior/Principal Consultant reports to a Team Leader and has responsibility for technical delivery of projects with collaboration of other team members and have technical leadership of more junior consultants besides project management. The role includes customer interaction to find solutions to their challenges and discuss project schedule/ delivery, technical issues and solutions. The Senior/Principal consultant will have opportunity to interact to customers and other offices globally.

What we offer

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

About You
Graduated in Engineering (Chemical or Mechanical desirable), for at least 6 years (mandatory)

M.Sc., Safety Eng. Post-Graduation, Process Safety or related (desirable)

Experience in CFD Advanced Modelling for Quantitative risk analysis such as Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis and Helideck Turbulence Analysis.

Experience in CFD tools such as FLACS and KFX. (very desirable)

Experience in CFD tools such as Ansys Fluent or CFX

Experience in Process Safety (PSM) and Qualitative Risk Analysis: (such as HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, Bow-Tie, Safety Case, EERA, etc). Experience in Vulnerability Analysis (PHAST), QRA (SAFETI) will be considered a differential.

Knowledge in Human Factors: HRA – Huma Reliability Analysis (Petro HRA will be considered a differential) and HFE – Human Factors Engineering.

Familiar with related to Brazilian regulations (onshore and offshore) - Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP requirements and NRs.

Experience in upstream, downstream and midstream.

Knowledge in programming language: VBA, Python and Digitalization mindset, will be considered a differential.

Besides Portuguese, fluent in English (mandatory)

Spanish will be considered a plus.

Behavior: presentation skills, proactive, constant skills, focused on solutions, multitasks (proposals, projects, presentations):

  • Excellent communication skills-including the ability to write clear and concise reports, both in Portuguese and English
  • Problem solving capacity
  • Critical thinking
  • Ability to pick up technical concepts quickly
  • Ability to completely undertake technical and no-technical (adm/finance matters) activities with limited supervision
  • Ability to speak with a wide variety of clients for the purpose of communicating DNV services and capabilities
  • Attention to detail
  • Self-motivated
  • Initiative independent of direct instruction
  • Ability to work on a team effectively and efficiently, but also be able to show effectiveness when working individually
  • Ability to handle fast pace, high demand environments with stress management skills
  • Actively seeks opportunities to help team members with demanding project schedules and expectations
  • Ability to work within tight deadline
  • Ability to coach junior staff

A equipe conecta estratégia, processos, sistemas, dados e controles para apoiar decisões mais rápidas, seguras e orientadas a resultado.

Buscamos profissional para atuar como analista de dados e governança para a área de Compras, garantindo:

  • qualidade e confiabilidade das informações de compras (SLA, spend, fornecedores, contratos e performance);
  • Indicadores e painéis para gestão e tomada de decisão;
  • Governança nas contratações - previsibilidade das demandas junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Apoio a iniciativas de transformação digital, com foco em S2P, automação de processos de compra orientada por dados e IA, melhoria da jornada do usuário e eficiência operacional.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Construir, manter e evoluir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais (KPIs de compras, produtividade, SLA, savings, ciclo de compra, compliance, spend por categoria/fornecedor etc.);

  • Executar análises de spend (classificação, concentração, tendências, oportunidades, riscos e anomalias);
  • Tratar e consolidar bases (ERP/SAP, portal de compras, planilhas, bases de fornecedores), garantindo integridade e rastreabilidade;
  • Apoiar análises para previsibilidade de OPEX e CAPEX (previsto x realizado, tendências, variações, projeções e premissas);
  • Apoiar a coordenação na padronização de processos e na documentação (fluxos, políticas, checklists, SLAs);
  • Contribuir com as rotinas de governança nas contratações (base de contratos, vencimentos de contratos, alertas, demandas em andamento, consolidação e visibilidade);
  • Preparar materiais executivos para comitês e liderança.

Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção,Administração, Economia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou Engenharia.

Conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Excel avançado (Power Query/Power Pivot, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, modelagem simples);
  • Power BI (construção de dashboards, modelagem de dados, DAX básico/intermediário);
  • Noções de governança de processos (mapeamento, indicadores, SLAs e controles);
  • Familiaridade com dados transacionais (pedidos, requisições, contratos, centros de custo, fornecedores);
  • Diferencial: SQL básico, Python (análise) e estatística aplicada.

Diferencial:

  • Vivência com ERP (SAP), especialmente MM ou módulos correlatos;
  • Vivência com plataformas S2P/e-Procurement.

Competências Técnicas:

  • Análise de dados e storytelling, transformar bases "cruas" em insights acionáveis e explicar números com clareza para públicos não técnicos.
  • Gestão de indicadores, definição, cálculo, meta, periodicidade, fonte e governança do KPI.
  • Visão de processo (end-to-end), entender o fluxo da compra e onde medir, controlar e melhorar.
  • Organização e qualidade, zelo por consistência e rastreabilidade.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Ética e confidencialidade.
  • Pensamento crítico e curiosidade.
  • Proatividade e melhoria contínua.
  • Comunicação e influência.
  • Orientação a resultado.
  • Resiliência e adaptação.

Informações adicionais

title: Especialista Comercial
description:
Somos o Grupo Energisa Com mais de cem anos de história, a Energisa é o maior grupo privado com controle 100% nacional do setor elétrico brasileiro. Nosso portfólio diversificado abrange distribuidoras, concessões de transmissão, geração de grande porte renovável, uma marca inovadora de soluções energéticas – a (re)energisa –, com geração distribuída por fonte renovável, comercialização de energia no mercado livre e serviços de valor agregado, além de uma central de serviços compartilhados, uma empresa de contact center e a fintech Voltz, a primeira do nosso setor no mercado de contas digitais. Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás. Transformamos, através de nossos mais de colaboradores, energia em conforto e desenvolvimento para mais de 20 milhões de pessoas. Acreditamos na força da diversidade e da pluralidade para gerar inovação e atingir resultados incríveis. Aqui todos são muito bem-vindos Quer fazer parte desta história? Confere se esta oportunidade tem match com o seu perfil e vem conosco participar desta jornada de seleção

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Analisar tendências de mercado, regulamentações setoriais e comportamento da concorrência para propor ajustes estratégicos, visando maximizar oportunidades e mitigar riscos.
  • Elaborar planos de ação comerciais, com definição de metas de curto, médio e longo prazo, alinhados aos objetivos corporativos e garantindo o cumprimento das metas de faturamento.
  • Apoiar o time comercial em relacionamentos estratégicos.
  • Garantir a sustentabilidade financeira dos projetos e a maximização da rentabilidade das soluções propostas, acompanhando de perto o processo de fechamento de contratos.
  • Atuar como consultor estratégico para os clientes, propondo soluções técnicas e comerciais inovadoras.
  • Apoiar processos de licitações, incluindo organização de documentos e suporte operacional.
  • Estabelecer e manter relações estratégicas com clientes corporativos, parceiros de negócios, órgãos reguladores e fornecedores, garantindo o alinhamento das necessidades comerciais da empresa com as expectativas do mercado.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, feiras e encontros do setor, fortalecendo a marca e ampliando a rede de contatos.
  • Gerenciar a contratação de fornecedores para feiras, eventos e ações institucionais, incluindo a produção de material de apoio.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de engenharia, comercial, operações e sustentabilidade e marketing, assegurando a viabilidade técnica e econômica das propostas e entrega dos projetos dentro do escopo, prazo e orçamento definidos.
  • Apoiar a liderança na capacitação e desenvolvimento a equipe comercial, promovendo a troca de conhecimento e assegurando o alinhamento estratégico das atividades de vendas com os objetivos da empresa.
  • Acompanhar, analisar e reportar indicadores de desempenho comerciais (KPIs), realizando ajustes nas estratégias conforme necessário para garantir o atingimento das metas de vendas.
  • Atuar como super user do CRM, sendo responsável pelo suporte, implantação, melhoria contínua e estruturação do sistema para as áreas comerciais

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Comercial, Energia, Sustentabilidade ou áreas afins.
  • Significativa experiencia na área comercial, em projetos de atuação direta na área de Geração Distribuída de Energia ou em setores de energia renovável, eficiência energética, ou projetos de infraestrutura relacionados.
  • Desejável experiência em empresas de grande porte ou com alto nível de complexidade no setor de energia.
  • CNH B ou superior.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nas plantas de biometano do grupo.
  • Desejável fluência em idiomas estrangeiros, especialmente inglês, para negociação com fornecedores e clientes globais.
  • ter experiência no desenvolvimento de novos produtos ou serviços no setor de energia será um grande diferencial.

Informações adicionais

As PESSOAS são nossa maior ENERGIA. Pensando em seu bem-estar, oferecemos um leque de benefícios.

Da só uma conferida no que você terá:

  • Vale alimentação ou Refeição para fazer as compras para sua casa ou comer no seu restaurante preferido;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família;
  • Previdência privada para sua reserva financeira e investimentos;
  • Seguro de Vida, para dar mais tranquilidade a você e a quem você ama;
  • Participação nos lucros, como incentivo pelo seu trabalho e resultados;
  • Programas de qualidade de vida que garantem o bem-estar e promovem a saúde dos nossos colaboradores;
  • Programas de Bolsa de Estudo para te apoiar em qualificação profissional;
  • Gympass que te dá acesso a mais de 18 mil academias no Brasil.

Se você possui os pré requisitos da vaga, faça sua candidatura e fique atento nas dicas:
• Durante a jornada do processo de seleção, a comunicação será via e-mail ou por telefone. Certifique que seus dados estão atualizados e fique de olho na sua caixa de e-mail, sem esquecer da caixa de spam. Fique atento nas ligações, os nossos telefones corporativos possuem variação de DDD.
• Caso receba um feedback negativo, não desanime, fique atento a outras oportunidades.

Você sabia que somos um dos maiores grupos do setor elétrico brasileiro? Com 120 anos de história, somos um ecossistema de produtos e serviços voltado para liderar a transformação energética, conectando pessoas e empresas à melhor solução de energia e construindo um mundo mais sustentável. Atuamos em 977 municípios de todas as regiões do Brasil, levando energia a mais de 20 milhões de pessoas.

Nosso trabalho mais visível é na distribuição de energia, mas temos muito mais a oferecer. Além das 9 distribuidoras de energia elétrica e 13 concessões de transmissão, contamos com uma central de geração fotovoltaica centralizada e um dos maiores parques de geração distribuída fotovoltaica do país, com a nossa marca inovadora (re)energisa. Também operamos no Mercado Livre de Energia, oferecendo soluções de valor agregado para nossos clientes.

Além disso, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a distribuição e comercialização de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás, e, desde novembro de 2024, com a participação nos ativos da Cegás, Copergás, Algás e Potigás. Estamos também investindo na geração, distribuição e comercialização de bio soluções, como biogás, biometano e biofertilizante, através da Agric.

Nossa missão é transformar energia em conforto, desenvolvimento e novas possibilidades com sustentabilidade. E para isso, contamos com cerca de 17 mil colaboradores que fazem a diferença todos os dias.

Você também pode ser parte dessa história de transformação.

Vamos juntos construir um mundo mais sustentável?

title: Globar Recruiter
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Role Description

Airswift is looking for a
Global Recruiter
to join our Rio de Janeiro office.

The
Global Recruiter
will focus on recruitment delivery to existing & new customers. The Global Recruiter will work in recruitment and will develop a deep understanding of the recruitment process while building strong relationships with candidates and clients. The professional will work closely with senior consultants to help meet client needs by sourcing, screening, and placing candidates across various roles.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Source suitable candidates for open job roles using various channels such as job boards, social media, networking, and internal databases.
  • Review resumes, conduct phone interviews, and assess candidates' skills and experience to match client requirements.
  • Present shortlisted candidates to clients, providing detailed profiles and relevant insights on their qualifications and experience.
  • Schedule and coordinate interviews between clients and candidates, ensuring a smooth process from start to finish.
  • Provide feedback to candidates after interviews and keep them updated on the hiring process. Communicate client feedback and help candidates prepare for interviews.
  • Assist with administrative tasks, including managing candidate data, preparing contracts or offers, and maintaining accurate records in the recruitment system.
  • Work closely with senior consultants and other team members to ensure recruitment targets are met and clients' needs are effectively addressed.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree (completed or about to be)
  • Fluent in English (Spoken and written)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, etc.) and an aptitude for learning new software tools.
  • Drive to meet and exceed targets, whether related to calls, submissions, interviews, and placements
  • Ability to work independently and stay motivated even during slow periods or after facing rejection.
  • Eagerness to learn about the recruitment industry and develop a career in recruitment.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, coordinate schedules, and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and able to work as part of a team to meet both individual and collective goals.
  • Open to learning and taking on new challenges, and comfortable with change in a dynamic environment.

What we can offer you

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values:

  • Growth
  • In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life
    – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence
  • We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity
  • We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Visit our website and social media to find out more -

They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

title: Accreditation Documentation
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.
The Accreditation Documentation & Training Material Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.
Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.
Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.
This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Accreditation Documentation & Content Management:
Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.
Training Material Development & Delivery:
Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.
Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination:
Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.
YOUR PROFILE
University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
Strong organisational and coordination skills.
Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
Experience developing training and instructional materials.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
